info.title: Vendor Section 32 pickup relay
info.description: Backend-only integration for Dispatch, Hauling and Taxi Goods. Each relay has an independent disabled-by-default capability flag. Vendor-owned delivery remains fail-closed pending an approved authority. Vendor stores opaque observations only; canonical lifecycle events drive order progress.

get.description: Authenticated business/branch-scoped read of a linked physical mission. No receiver credentials.

post.description: Staff with vendor.orders.manage relays provider-presented pickup credentials. Authority is resolved from the frozen mission. Canonical idempotency owns replay; unknown outcomes are read back without a second mutation. No offline confirmation.

200.description: Canonical handover observation; HTTP success alone does not establish custody

503.description: HANDOVER_NOT_AVAILABLE or HANDOVER_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; reconcile by read-back
